title: ctdR: Enrichment Analysis of Chemical-Gene Interactions from the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database
description:
ctdR is an R tool for hypothesis discovery: it surfaces candidate chemicals associated with a set of genes, using data from the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD), for exploratory follow-up rather than confirmatory inference. The four enrichment methods it exposes through a unified interface — ORA, GSEA, CAMERA and GSVA — are the underlying means, not the end.

📖 Documentation, tutorials & function reference
